segments.text: Anthropic cloud design generates productionready UI on a canvas, but it's closed source, cloudon, and paywalled.
Open design is the local first open- source alternative. Plugs into claude code, cursor, codec, Gemini CLI, open code, and local Quinn. 19 design skills,
71 branded design systems. Chat in your terminal. It renders into a sandbox preview, then exports straight to HTML, PDF, or PowerPoint.
